what: An LSDJ-style tracker on an OPL3-style FM engine, with 2,103 presets. The keyboard doubles as a gamepad to write songs fast, with FX inspired by circuit bending, a drum machine and a looper. Songs open and export as AdLib Tracker II .A2M files.
author: Audren
sounds: licensed: instrument presets from AdLib Tracker II, LGPL-2.1+
